referee_caveats_inferred: The abstract gives an equatorial VMR of 1.92 ppb, while the main text gives 1.66 ppb above the equivalent pressure level; these are conflicting answer keys.
The reported VMR errors do not establish robustness to the adopted temperature profile, pressure cutoff, beam approximation or calibration systematics.
The temperature argument relies on literature observations from different epochs rather than a simultaneous temperature map.
The circulation and impact interpretations are morphological comparisons, without fitted transport or impact models.
The supplied conversion omits some atmospheric species and reactions, preventing recovery of the complete atmospheric model from this text.

evidence.loc: Image synthesis of ALMA archived data
evidence.quote: We analyzed an archived ALMA data of project ID 2015.1.01471.S (PI: R. Moreno)

missing_for_reproduction: Executable analysis scripts, extracted spectra and a saved PSG configuration.
Continuum-separation settings and exact imaging mask.
Radial polynomial and latitude-profile construction details.
Exact extraction locations, geometry registration and image-to-temperature conversion.
The numerical adopted temperature profile, background atmospheric profiles and spectroscopic database release.
Resolution of the abstract/main-text equatorial abundance discrepancy.
An explicit public-access statement; the paper identifies the data as archived.
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Cannot estimate reliably from the reported antenna count, one spectral window and observing time alone.
reproducibility.score_reason: 6/10: project, CASA version, principal imaging settings and basic retrieval assumptions are supplied. Missing analysis settings, model configuration and conflicting abundance values prevent an exact numerical reproduction.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Main results are numeric and archived data are identified, but public access is not explicitly stated and the extraction, normalization and retrieval recipe is incomplete.
